metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the last rehearsal, the afternoon at home, the oath in the door, and a short memo.

yesterday: The column beside Costard is still open.
Tomorrow is two of the clock, the first time a yard hears it. The refusal stays. The messenger stays small.
The company played The Shrew at two. You stayed at the lodging.
Alse has never seen a play. She heard the oath and asked who cooks. Mistress Ansell stopped it after eight.
